title: Sign up and create an OTA until it is provisioned
summary: A new owner signs up, verifies the address, turns on two-factor sign-in, creates an OTA in the wizard and watches the platform and OTA workers provision it; then reveals the test keys and opens the new storefront.
prerequisites: [[journey:run-the-stack]] done: both backends (API and worker), the portal, Mailpit and the stub are running.
Pick a fresh e-mail address such as `owner1@example.com` and an OTA key such as `acme1` (3 to 30 lower-case letters and digits, starting with a letter).

steps.title: Sign up (and see the password rule)
steps.actions: Fill **Full name**, **E-mail address**, **Password** `Too-short-1`, tick *I accept the terms of service* and press **Create account**. Then type a password of 12+ characters with a letter and a digit and press **Create account** again.
steps.expect: The short password is refused at the field (the e-mail stays filled in). The valid one lands on `/sign-up/check-email`.
steps.data: `SELECT status, email_verified_at FROM platform.accounts WHERE email = 'owner1@example.com';` → `pending_verification`, null. `SELECT template, status FROM platform.email_outbox ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;` → `auth.verify_email`, `sent` once the worker ran. Mailpit: "Confirm your e-mail address for Velexis".

steps.title: Sign up again with the same address
steps.actions: Sign up once more with the same address and another name and password.
steps.expect: The same `/sign-up/check-email` page (nothing reveals that the address exists). Mailpit gets "You already have a Velexis account" instead of a second verification link.
steps.data: Still one row in `platform.accounts` for the address; `email_outbox` has an `auth.account_exists` row.

steps.title: Verify the address through the Mailpit link
steps.actions: In Mailpit open the verification e-mail and click its link (it points at `http://localhost:3000/verify-email?token=…`). Click the same link a second time.
steps.expect: First click: `/sign-in?verified=1` with *Your e-mail address is verified. Sign in to continue.*; the token is gone from the address bar. Second click: `/verify-pending?error=token` with *This verification link has expired or was already used* (single use).

steps.title: Sign in
steps.actions: Sign in with the address and password.
steps.expect: `/dashboard` ("My OTAs") with the empty state "You have no OTA yet" and the **Create an OTA** button at the top. Cookies `__Host-vxp_at` and `__Host-vxp_rt` are httpOnly.

steps.title: Turn on two-factor sign-in
steps.actions: Press **Set up two-factor authentication**, add the key shown as *Or enter this key in the app* to your authenticator, type a code in **Authentication code** and press **Turn on two-factor authentication**. Save the recovery codes. Sign out, then sign in again.
steps.expect: Ten recovery codes are shown once; after a reload the set-up key is gone. The next sign-in asks for a code on `/sign-in/mfa` (**Verify and sign in**) before `/dashboard`.
steps.data: `SELECT count(*) FROM platform.account_recovery_codes WHERE account_id = 'acc_…';` → 10. The account's MFA secret column holds ciphertext only.

steps.title: Create the OTA in the wizard
steps.actions: Press **Create an OTA**. Type **OTA name**, then **OTA key**: try `demo`, `admin` and `1abc` first, then your key. Choose **Country** and **Default currency** (time zone is prefilled). **Continue** → Plan (early access) → **Continue** → Review → **Create OTA**. Double-click the last button on purpose.
steps.expect: Reserved and malformed keys are refused as you type (*This key is reserved by Velexis…*, *Use 3 to 30 lower-case letters…*; upper-case letters are lower-cased as you type); a free key shows *This key is available.* and *Storefront address: `<key>`.ota.example.com*. The plan step says every new OTA starts on the early access plan. After **Create OTA** you land on `/otas/ten_…/setup` with **Set-up steps**; the double click creates one OTA (Idempotency-Key).
steps.data: One transaction: `platform.tenants` (`provisioning`, `storefront_environment = test`), `tenant_memberships` (`owner`), `subscriptions` (manual trial of `early_access`), `tenant_domains` (`<key>.ota.example.com`, verified, primary), `provisioning_jobs` (`kind = provision`), audit `tenant.created`. Redis: a job in `vx:ota-tenant-ops:*` with id `job_…-1`.

steps.title: Watch the set-up finish
steps.actions: Stay on the set-up page (it polls every 2 seconds). Watch the OTA worker's and platform worker's terminals.
steps.expect: Within about a minute the heading becomes **Your OTA is ready** and the `activate` step shows *Done*. No error lines in either worker.
steps.data: `SELECT status, step, attempt, steps FROM platform.provisioning_jobs WHERE tenant_id = 'ten_…';` → `succeeded` with `record_migrations`, `assign_amadeus_office`, `create_payment_connection`, `issue_api_keys`, `activate`, `notify` all succeeded. `platform.tenants.status` → `active`, `schema_version` set. `\dt tenant_<key>.*` lists the tenant tables. `platform.supplier_connections` (test, `active`, one `DEV1A…` office), `platform.payment_provider_connections` (stripe, test, `velexis`, `active`), two `platform.api_keys`. In the tenant: `storefront_settings`, the default `markup_rules` row and `notification_templates` are seeded.

steps.title: Reveal the test keys once
steps.actions: Press **Reveal the test keys**. Copy both. Reload the page.
steps.expect: **Your test API keys** shows *Publishable test key* `pk_test_` + 40 characters and *Secret test key* `sk_test_` + 40 characters; the button disappears. After the reload: *The initial keys were already shown* and no key anywhere in the page source.
steps.data: The provisioning job's reveal ciphertext is erased and `revealed_at` set in the same update; keys never appear in logs (search the platform API log for `sk_test_`: nothing).

steps.title: See the onboarding checklist and the welcome e-mail
steps.actions: Press **Go to the OTA dashboard**. Look at the region **Get your OTA ready**. Check Mailpit.
steps.expect: Items: Verify your e-mail *Done*, Turn on two-factor sign-in *Done*, OTA set up *Done*, Get your API keys *Done*, Open your storefront *Done*, Amadeus test office active *Done*, Invite your team *To do* (a link to `/otas/ten_…/team`); the progress line reads "6 of 7 done". Mailpit: "`<OTA name>` is ready on Velexis".

steps.title: Open the new OTA's storefront locally
steps.actions: Create `ota/frontend/.env.local` with `STOREFRONT_DEV_HOST=<key>.ota.example.com` and restart `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-frontend dev`. Open the home page and search MAD → PAR.
steps.expect: The header shows your OTA's name and the "Test mode" note; the search lists the stub's 5 flights priced with the seeded default markup (0 %).
steps.data: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant_<key>.flight_searches;` grows; `tenant_demo` does not change (isolation).
